---
title: "Sex & Lifespan — Sleep & Physical Strength"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(survey)
library(splines)
library(broom)
library(plotly)
library(jsonlite)
library(scales)

fmt1 <- \(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)

# 1. Load preserved 10,987-participant dataset + construct verified NHANES MEC design
df <- read_rds("data/processed/nhanes_sleep_strength.rds") |>
  mutate(
    age_band_14 = cut(
      age,
      breaks = c(15, 19, 24, 29, 34, 39, 44, 49, 54, 59, 64, 69, 74, 79, 85),
      labels = c(
        "16–19", "20–24", "25–29", "30–34", "35–39", "40–44", "45–49",
        "50–54", "55–59", "60–64", "65–69", "70–74", "75–79", "80+"
      )
    )
  )

demo_mec <- bind_rows(
  read_xpt("data/raw/DEMO_G.XPT") |> select(SEQN, SDMVPSU, SDMVSTRA, WTMEC2YR),
  read_xpt("data/raw/DEMO_H.XPT") |> select(SEQN, SDMVPSU, SDMVSTRA, WTMEC2YR)
) |>
  filter(WTMEC2YR > 0) |>
  mutate(mec_weight_4yr = WTMEC2YR / 2) |>
  left_join(df |> select(-mec_weight_4yr) |> mutate(in_cohort = TRUE), by = "SEQN") |>
  mutate(in_cohort = coalesce(in_cohort, FALSE))

des_mec_full <- svydesign(
  id = ~SDMVPSU, strata = ~SDMVSTRA, weights = ~mec_weight_4yr,
  nest = TRUE, data = demo_mec
)
des_analytic <- subset(des_mec_full, in_cohort)

n_total <- nrow(df)
n_male <- sum(df$sex == "Male")
n_female <- sum(df$sex == "Female")
n_75plus <- sum(df$age_group == "75-80+")
n_75_79 <- sum(df$age >= 75 & df$age <= 79)
n_topcoded80 <- sum(df$age == 80)
n_top80_m <- sum(df$age == 80 & df$sex == "Male")
n_top80_f <- sum(df$age == 80 & df$sex == "Female")

# 2. Lifespan summary metrics (Peak 30-44 vs Older 75-80+ in Survey-Weighted Design)
svy_stage_sex <- svyby(
  ~combined_grip_kg, ~sex + age_group,
  design = des_analytic, FUN = svymean, vartype = "ci"
) |>
  as_tibble()

peak_m <- svy_stage_sex |> filter(sex == "Male", age_group == "30-44") |> pull(combined_grip_kg)
old_m  <- svy_stage_sex |> filter(sex == "Male", age_group == "75-80+") |> pull(combined_grip_kg)
drop_m_pct <- round((1 - old_m / peak_m) * 100, 1)

peak_f <- svy_stage_sex |> filter(sex == "Female", age_group == "30-44") |> pull(combined_grip_kg)
old_f  <- svy_stage_sex |> filter(sex == "Female", age_group == "75-80+") |> pull(combined_grip_kg)
drop_f_pct <- round((1 - old_f / peak_f) * 100, 1)

# 3. Discrete 14-bin lifespan profile + svyglm natural-spline curve (ages 16 to 80)
band_midpoints <- c(17.5, 22, 27, 32, 37, 42, 47, 52, 57, 62, 67, 72, 77, 80)

svy_14 <- svyby(
  ~combined_grip_kg, ~sex + age_band_14,
  design = des_analytic, FUN = svymean, vartype = "ci"
) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rename(w_mean = combined_grip_kg, w_lo = ci_l, w_hi = ci_u)

unw_14 <- df |>
  group_by(sex, age_band_14) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    u_mean = mean(combined_grip_kg),
    u_se = sd(combined_grip_kg) / sqrt(n()),
    u_lo = u_mean - qt(0.975, pmax(n() - 1L, 1L)) * u_se,
    u_hi = u_mean + qt(0.975, pmax(n() - 1L, 1L)) * u_se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lifespan_bins <- unw_14 |>
  left_join(svy_14, by = c("sex", "age_band_14")) |>
  mutate(
    band_idx = match(as.character(age_band_14), levels(df$age_band_14)),
    mid_age = band_midpoints[band_idx],
    sex = as.character(sex),
    age_band = as.character(age_band_14),
    across(c(u_mean, u_lo, u_hi, w_mean, w_lo, w_hi), \(v) round(v, 1))
  ) |>
  select(sex, age_band, mid_age, n, u_mean, u_lo, u_hi, w_mean, w_lo, w_hi)

# Smooth reference model on integer ages 16..80 via survey::svyglm
m_life_svy <- svyglm(combined_grip_kg ~ sex * ns(age, df = 5), design = des_analytic)
pred_grid <- expand_grid(
  sex = factor(c("Male", "Female"), levels = c("Male", "Female")),
  age = 16:80
)
mm_grid <- model.matrix(~ sex * ns(age, df = 5), data = pred_grid)
beta_hat <- coef(m_life_svy)
vcov_hat <- vcov(m_life_svy)
fit_vals <- as.numeric(mm_grid %*% beta_hat)
se_vals  <- sqrt(rowSums((mm_grid %*% vcov_hat) * mm_grid))
t_crit   <- qt(0.975, df = degf(des_analytic) - length(beta_hat))

lifespan_curve <- pred_grid |>
  mutate(
    sex = as.character(sex),
    fit = round(fit_vals, 2),
    lo = round(fit_vals - t_crit * se_vals, 2),
    hi = round(fit_vals + t_crit * se_vals, 2)
  )

# 4. Upgraded Discrete Age Group x Sleep Category Matrix (Sex-Separated, Unsmoothed)
svy_mat <- svyby(
  ~combined_grip_kg, ~sex + age_group + sleep_category,
  design = des_analytic, FUN = svymean, vartype = "ci"
) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rename(w_mean = combined_grip_kg, w_lo = ci_l, w_hi = ci_u)

unw_mat <- df |>
  group_by(sex, age_group, sleep_category) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    u_mean = mean(combined_grip_kg),
    u_se = sd(combined_grip_kg) / sqrt(n()),
    u_lo = u_mean - qt(0.975, pmax(n() - 1L, 1L)) * u_se,
    u_hi = u_mean + qt(0.975, pmax(n() - 1L, 1L)) * u_se,
    u_med = median(combined_grip_kg),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

matrix_cells <- unw_mat |>
  left_join(svy_mat, by = c("sex", "age_group", "sleep_category")) |>
  mutate(
    sex = as.character(sex),
    age_group = as.character(age_group),
    sleep_category = as.character(sleep_category),
    across(c(u_mean, u_lo, u_hi, u_med, w_mean, w_lo, w_hi), \(v) round(v, 1))
  )

# 5. Demographic Subgroup Analysis (RIDRETH3 x Sex: Unweighted vs Survey-Weighted)
svy_demo <- svyby(
  ~combined_grip_kg, ~sex + race_ethnicity,
  design = des_analytic, FUN = svymean, vartype = "ci"
) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rename(w_mean = combined_grip_kg, w_lo = ci_l, w_hi = ci_u)

unw_demo <- df |>
  group_by(sex, race_ethnicity) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    u_mean = mean(combined_grip_kg),
    u_se = sd(combined_grip_kg) / sqrt(n()),
    u_lo = u_mean - qt(0.975, pmax(n() - 1L, 1L)) * u_se,
    u_hi = u_mean + qt(0.975, pmax(n() - 1L, 1L)) * u_se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

demo_cells <- unw_demo |>
  left_join(svy_demo, by = c("sex", "race_ethnicity")) |>
  mutate(
    sex = as.character(sex),
    across(c(u_mean, u_lo, u_hi, w_mean, w_lo, w_hi), \(v) round(v, 1))
  )

# Demographic sampling weights & short-sleep table
w_tot <- sum(df$mec_weight_4yr)
demo_sampling_tab <- df |>
  group_by(race_ethnicity) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    unw_pct = round(n() / nrow(df) * 100, 1),
    wtd_pct = round(sum(mec_weight_4yr) / w_tot * 100, 1),
    short_sleep_pct = round(weighted.mean(sleep_hours <= 6, mec_weight_4yr) * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(wtd_pct))

nhb_short <- demo_sampling_tab |> filter(race_ethnicity == "Non-Hispanic Black") |> pull(short_sleep_pct)
nhw_short <- demo_sampling_tab |> filter(race_ethnicity == "Non-Hispanic White") |> pull(short_sleep_pct)
nhb_unw_share <- demo_sampling_tab |> filter(race_ethnicity == "Non-Hispanic Black") |> pull(unw_pct)
nhb_wtd_share <- demo_sampling_tab |> filter(race_ethnicity == "Non-Hispanic Black") |> pull(wtd_pct)

# Explicit regression comparison with vs without RIDRETH3 to verify covariate adjustment directly
df_ref <- df |> mutate(sleep_cat_ref = relevel(sleep_category, ref = "Recommended (7-8h)"))
m_unw_norace <- lm(combined_grip_kg ~ sleep_cat_ref + sex * ns(age, df = 5), data = df_ref)
m_unw_race   <- lm(combined_grip_kg ~ sleep_cat_ref + race_ethnicity + sex * ns(age, df = 5), data = df_ref)
m_svy_check  <- svyglm(
  combined_grip_kg ~ relevel(sleep_category, ref = "Recommended (7-8h)") + sex * ns(age, df = 5),
  design = des_analytic
)

est_5h_norace <- round(coef(m_unw_norace)[["sleep_cat_refVery Short (<=5h)"]], 2)
est_5h_race   <- round(coef(m_unw_race)[["sleep_cat_refVery Short (<=5h)"]], 2)
pval_5h_race  <- round(summary(m_unw_race)$coefficients["sleep_cat_refVery Short (<=5h)", 4], 2)
svy_5h_td     <- tidy(m_svy_check) |> filter(str_detect(term, "Very Short"))
est_5h_svy    <- round(svy_5h_td$estimate, 2)
pval_5h_svy   <- round(svy_5h_td$p.value, 2)
min_cell_n    <- min(matrix_cells$n)

life_payload <- toJSON(
  list(
    bins = lifespan_bins,
    curve = lifespan_curve,
    matrix = matrix_cells,
    demo = demo_cells
  ),
  dataframe = "columns",
  auto_unbox = TRUE
)

dep_widget <- plot_ly() |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender("function(el) { el.style.display = 'none'; }")
```

<h1 class="hero-title" style="font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 3.4vw, 2.75rem);">
Biological Sex &amp; the <span class="gradient-text">Lifespan Strength Arc</span>
</h1>
<p class="hero-subtitle" style="margin-bottom: 1.1rem;">
Normative life-course studies establish that human grip strength rises through adolescence, peaks in early-to-mid adulthood, and declines steadily in later life, with substantial separation between men and women (<a href="about.html#references" style="color: #38bdf8; text-decoration: none;">Dodds et al., 2014</a>). Reproducing this trajectory in our `r comma(n_total)` NHANES examinees (`ages 16–80+`) demonstrates why sex dimorphism and nonlinear aging must be modeled before interpreting any sleep association.
</p>

<div class="rq-callout">
<div class="rq-label">Chapter 2 Analytical Takeaway</div>
<p class="rq-question">
Combined grip strength peaks in ages `30–44` (`r fmt1(peak_m)` kg Male, `r fmt1(peak_f)` kg Female survey-weighted means) before declining `r fmt1(drop_m_pct)`% in men and `r fmt1(drop_f_pct)`% in women by ages `75–80+`—an age swing over ten times larger than typical sleep-tier differences.
</p>
</div>
</section>

<div class="finding-note">
<strong>Why linear age adjustment fails:</strong> Because male combined grip rises from `~83 kg` at ages `16–19` to `~98 kg` at `30–34` before falling to `~64 kg` at `80+`, fitting a straight line for age misrepresents both adolescents/young adults and older adults. Both ends of that nonlinear curve (`16–19` and `75–80+`) also contain higher proportions of `9+h` sleepers—which is why flexible nonlinear age modeling (`ns(age, df = 5)`) was used in Chapter 1.
</div>
</section>

<div class="finding-note">
<strong>Distinguishing descriptive subgroup differences from covariate adjustment and survey weighting:</strong> The chart and table above document descriptive differences across NHANES `RIDRETH3` categories—for example, Non-Hispanic Black examinees represent `r fmt1(nhb_unw_share)`% of the unweighted sample (oversampled relative to their `r fmt1(nhb_wtd_share)`% MEC-weighted U.S. population share; <a href="about.html#references" style="color: #38bdf8; text-decoration: none;">CDC/NCHS Analytic Guidelines, 2018</a>) and exhibit both higher mean grip strength and higher weighted `&le;6h` sleep prevalence (`r fmt1(nhb_short)`% vs. `r fmt1(nhw_short)`% in Non-Hispanic White examinees). Descriptive differences alone do not prove statistical confounding, so we verified this directly via regression comparison: in unweighted `sex * ns(age, df = 5)` OLS, adding `RIDRETH3` shifts the `&le;5h` vs. `7–8h` coefficient from `r sprintf("%+.2f", est_5h_norace)` kg to `r sprintf("%+.2f", est_5h_race)` kg (`p = `r sprintf("%.2f", pval_5h_race)``). Applying MEC survey weights (`WTMEC2YR / 2`) separately recalibrates the sample to target U.S. population proportions (`r sprintf("%+.2f", est_5h_svy)` kg, `p = `r sprintf("%.2f", pval_5h_svy)`` in Chapter 1's Model 4), without implying any biological or causal mechanism behind subgroup differences.
</div>
</section>

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  let curveMode = "w";
  let matMode = "w";
  let demoMode = "w";

  function renderLifespanCurve() {
    const B = LIFE_DATA.bins;
    const C = LIFE_DATA.curve;
    const traces = [];

    const badge = document.getElementById("life-curve-badge");
    if (curveMode === "w") {
      badge.className = "method-badge badge-weighted";
      badge.textContent = "NHANES Survey-Weighted 5-Year Band Means + Spline Ribbon (95% CI)";
    } else {
      badge.className = "method-badge badge-descriptive";
      badge.textContent = "Unweighted 5-Year Band Sample Means (95% CI)";
    }

    const sexConfigs = [
      { sex: "Male", color: "#38bdf8", fill: "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.16)" },
      { sex: "Female", color: "#f472b6", fill: "rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.16)" }
    ];

    sexConfigs.forEach(cfg => {
      if (curveMode === "w") {
        const cIdx = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < C.sex.length; i++) {
          if (C.sex[i] === cfg.sex) cIdx.push(i);
        }
        traces.push({
          type: "scatter",
          mode: "lines",
          x: cIdx.map(i => C.age[i]),
          y: cIdx.map(i => C.hi[i]),
          line: { width: 0 },
          hoverinfo: "skip",
          showlegend: false
        });
        traces.push({
          type: "scatter",
          mode: "lines",
          name: cfg.sex + " Survey Spline (95% CI)",
          x: cIdx.map(i => C.age[i]),
          y: cIdx.map(i => C.lo[i]),
          fill: "tonexty",
          fillcolor: cfg.fill,
          line: { width: 0 },
          hoverinfo: "skip",
          showlegend: false
        });
        traces.push({
          type: "scatter",
          mode: "lines",
          name: cfg.sex + " Spline Fit (svyglm)",
          x: cIdx.map(i => C.age[i]),
          y: cIdx.map(i => C.fit[i]),
          line: { color: cfg.color, width: 2.6 },
          hovertemplate: "<b>" + cfg.sex + " Age %{x}</b><br>Spline Predicted Mean: %{y:.1f} kg<extra></extra>"
        });
      }

      const bIdx = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < B.sex.length; i++) {
        if (B.sex[i] === cfg.sex) bIdx.push(i);
      }

      const ys = bIdx.map(i => (curveMode === "w" ? B.w_mean[i] : B.u_mean[i]));
      const los = bIdx.map(i => (curveMode === "w" ? B.w_lo[i] : B.u_lo[i]));
      const his = bIdx.map(i => (curveMode === "w" ? B.w_hi[i] : B.u_hi[i]));

      traces.push({
        type: "scatter",
        mode: "markers",
        name: cfg.sex + (curveMode === "w" ? " 5-Yr Weighted Mean" : " 5-Yr Sample Mean"),
        x: bIdx.map(i => B.mid_age[i]),
        y: ys,
        customdata: bIdx.map((i, k) => [B.age_band[i], B.n[i], los[k].toFixed(1), his[k].toFixed(1)]),
        marker: {
          size: 9,
          color: "#ffffff",
          line: { color: cfg.color, width: 2.4 }
        },
        error_y: {
          type: "data",
          symmetric: false,
          array: ys.map((m, k) => Number((his[k] - m).toFixed(2))),
          arrayminus: ys.map((m, k) => Number((m - los[k]).toFixed(2))),
          visible: true,
          color: cfg.color,
          thickness: 2,
          width: 4
        },
        hovertemplate:
          "<b>" + cfg.sex + " &middot; Ages %{customdata[0]}</b> (n = %{customdata[1]})<br>" +
          "Mean Combined Grip: <b>%{y:.1f} kg</b> [95% CI: %{customdata[2]}–%{customdata[3]} kg]<extra></extra>"
      });
    });

    const layout = {
      paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor: "rgba(8,13,26,0.72)",
      margin: { t: 28, r: 24, b: 62, l: 68 },
      font: { family: "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif", color: "#cbd5e1" },
      xaxis: {
        range: [14.5, 82.5],
        tickvals: [17.5, 25, 35, 45, 55, 65, 75, 80],
        ticktext: ["16–19", "25", "35", "45", "55", "65", "75", "80+ (Top-Coded)"],
        title: { text: "Participant Age Across the Lifespan (Years)", font: { size: 13, color: "#f8fafc" } },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.10)"
      },
      yaxis: {
        range: [30, 108],
        title: { text: "Combined Bilateral Grip Strength (kg)", font: { size: 13, color: "#f8fafc" } },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.12)"
      },
      legend: { orientation: "h", x: 0, y: 1.11, font: { size: 11.5, color: "#e2e8f0" } }
    };

    Plotly.react("plot-lifespan-curve", traces, layout, { responsive: true, displaylogo: false });
  }

  function buildDiscreteMatrix(sexName, axisSuffix, cScale, zMin, zMax, cbarX) {
    const M = LIFE_DATA.matrix;
    const ageLevels = ["16-29", "30-44", "45-59", "60-74", "75-80+"];
    const sleepLevels = [
      "Very Short (<=5h)",
      "Short (6h)",
      "Recommended (7-8h)",
      "Long (9+h)"
    ];
    const shortSleepLabels = ["≤5h Very Short", "6h Short", "7–8h Rec.", "9+h Long"];

    const zMat = [];
    const textMat = [];
    const hoverMat = [];

    ageLevels.forEach(ag => {
      const zRow = [];
      const tRow = [];
      const hRow = [];
      sleepLevels.forEach((sc, scIdx) => {
        let idx = -1;
        for (let i = 0; i < M.sex.length; i++) {
          if (M.sex[i] === sexName && M.age_group[i] === ag && M.sleep_category[i] === sc) {
            idx = i;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (idx >= 0) {
          const val = matMode === "w" ? M.w_mean[idx] : M.u_mean[idx];
          const lo = matMode === "w" ? M.w_lo[idx] : M.u_lo[idx];
          const hi = matMode === "w" ? M.w_hi[idx] : M.u_hi[idx];
          const n = M.n[idx];
          zRow.push(val);
          tRow.push("<b>" + val.toFixed(1) + " kg</b><br><span style='font-size:10.5px'>n=" + n + "</span>");
          hRow.push(
            "<b>" + sexName + " &middot; Ages " + ag + " &middot; " + shortSleepLabels[scIdx] + "</b><br>" +
            (matMode === "w" ? "Survey-Weighted Mean: " : "Unweighted Sample Mean: ") +
            "<b>" + val.toFixed(1) + " kg</b> [95% CI: " + lo.toFixed(1) + "–" + hi.toFixed(1) + " kg]<br>" +
            "Sample Median: " + M.u_med[idx].toFixed(1) + " kg &middot; Cell Count: n = " + n
          );
        }
      });
      zMat.push(zRow);
      textMat.push(tRow);
      hoverMat.push(hRow);
    });

    return {
      type: "heatmap",
      xaxis: "x" + axisSuffix,
      yaxis: "y" + axisSuffix,
      x: shortSleepLabels,
      y: ageLevels.map(a => "Ages " + a),
      z: zMat,
      text: textMat,
      texttemplate: "%{text}",
      textfont: { size: 11.5, color: "#f8fafc" },
      customdata: hoverMat,
      hovertemplate: "%{customdata}<extra></extra>",
      zsmooth: false,
      zmin: zMin,
      zmax: zMax,
      xgap: 3,
      ygap: 3,
      colorscale: cScale,
      colorbar: {
        title: { text: sexName + " (kg)", font: { size: 11, color: "#cbd5e1" } },
        tickfont: { size: 10.5, color: "#94a3b8" },
        len: 0.86,
        thickness: 12,
        x: cbarX,
        outlinewidth: 0
      }
    };
  }

  function renderLifespanMatrix() {
    const badge = document.getElementById("life-mat-badge");
    if (matMode === "w") {
      badge.className = "method-badge badge-weighted";
      badge.textContent = "NHANES Survey-Weighted Cell Means (Unsmoothed Discrete Grid)";
    } else {
      badge.className = "method-badge badge-descriptive";
      badge.textContent = "Unweighted Sample Cell Means (Unsmoothed Discrete Grid)";
    }

    const maleScale = [
      [0.0, "#172554"],
      [0.45, "#0369a1"],
      [0.8, "#0284c7"],
      [1.0, "#2dd4bf"]
    ];
    const femaleScale = [
      [0.0, "#2e1065"],
      [0.45, "#6d28d9"],
      [0.8, "#be185d"],
      [1.0, "#f472b6"]
    ];

    const mHeat = buildDiscreteMatrix("Male", "", maleScale, 58, 100, 0.455);
    const fHeat = buildDiscreteMatrix("Female", "2", femaleScale, 35, 64, 1.01);

    const layout = {
      paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor: "rgba(8,13,26,0.72)",
      margin: { t: 54, r: 58, b: 60, l: 88 },
      font: { family: "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif", color: "#cbd5e1" },
      xaxis: {
        domain: [0, 0.42],
        title: { text: "Nightly Sleep Tier (Males)", font: { size: 12, color: "#cbd5e1" } }
      },
      yaxis: {
        autorange: "reversed",
        tickfont: { size: 12, color: "#f8fafc" }
      },
      xaxis2: {
        domain: [0.56, 0.98],
        anchor: "y2",
        title: { text: "Nightly Sleep Tier (Females)", font: { size: 12, color: "#cbd5e1" } }
      },
      yaxis2: {
        anchor: "x2",
        autorange: "reversed",
        tickfont: { size: 12, color: "#f8fafc" }
      },
      annotations: [
        {
          xref: "paper", yref: "paper", x: 0.21, y: 1.07,
          xanchor: "center", yanchor: "bottom", showarrow: false,
          text: "<b style='color:#7dd3fc;font-size:13.5px'>MALES (n = 5,420)</b> <span style='color:#94a3b8;font-size:11.5px'>Scale: 58–100 kg</span>"
        },
        {
          xref: "paper", yref: "paper", x: 0.77, y: 1.07,
          xanchor: "center", yanchor: "bottom", showarrow: false,
          text: "<b style='color:#f9a8d4;font-size:13.5px'>FEMALES (n = 5,567)</b> <span style='color:#94a3b8;font-size:11.5px'>Scale: 35–64 kg</span>"
        }
      ]
    };

    Plotly.react("plot-lifespan-matrix", [mHeat, fHeat], layout, { responsive: true, displaylogo: false });
  }

  function renderDemoBars() {
    const D = LIFE_DATA.demo;
    const groups = [
      "Non-Hispanic Black",
      "Other / Multi-Racial",
      "Non-Hispanic White",
      "Mexican American",
      "Other Hispanic",
      "Non-Hispanic Asian"
    ];
    const badge = document.getElementById("demo-mode-badge");
    if (demoMode === "w") {
      badge.className = "method-badge badge-weighted";
      badge.textContent = "NHANES Survey-Weighted Subgroup Means (95% CI)";
    } else {
      badge.className = "method-badge badge-descriptive";
      badge.textContent = "Unweighted Sample Subgroup Means (95% CI)";
    }

    const sexConfigs = [
      { sex: "Male", color: "#38bdf8" },
      { sex: "Female", color: "#f472b6" }
    ];

    const traces = sexConfigs.map(cfg => {
      const xs = [];
      const ys = [];
      const hiArr = [];
      const loArr = [];
      const cdata = [];

      groups.forEach(g => {
        for (let i = 0; i < D.sex.length; i++) {
          if (D.sex[i] === cfg.sex && D.race_ethnicity[i] === g) {
            const m = demoMode === "w" ? D.w_mean[i] : D.u_mean[i];
            const lo = demoMode === "w" ? D.w_lo[i] : D.u_lo[i];
            const hi = demoMode === "w" ? D.w_hi[i] : D.u_hi[i];
            xs.push(g.replace("Non-Hispanic ", "NH "));
            ys.push(m);
            hiArr.push(Number((hi - m).toFixed(2)));
            loArr.push(Number((m - lo).toFixed(2)));
            cdata.push([g, D.n[i], lo.toFixed(1), hi.toFixed(1)]);
          }
        }
      });

      return {
        type: "bar",
        name: cfg.sex,
        x: xs,
        y: ys,
        customdata: cdata,
        marker: { color: cfg.color, opacity: 0.88 },
        error_y: {
          type: "data",
          symmetric: false,
          array: hiArr,
          arrayminus: loArr,
          visible: true,
          color: "#f8fafc",
          thickness: 1.6,
          width: 4
        },
        hovertemplate:
          "<b>%{customdata[0]} (" + cfg.sex + ")</b><br>" +
          "Mean Grip: <b>%{y:.1f} kg</b> [95% CI: %{customdata[2]}–%{customdata[3]} kg]<br>" +
          "Sample Count: n = %{customdata[1]}<extra></extra>"
      };
    });

    const layout = {
      barmode: "group",
      paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor: "rgba(8,13,26,0.72)",
      margin: { t: 28, r: 22, b: 68, l: 66 },
      font: { family: "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif", color: "#cbd5e1" },
      xaxis: { tickfont: { size: 12, color: "#f8fafc" }, gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.08)" },
      yaxis: {
        range: [0, 105],
        title: { text: "Combined Bilateral Grip Strength (kg)", font: { size: 13, color: "#f8fafc" } },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.12)"
      },
      legend: { orientation: "h", x: 0, y: 1.12, font: { size: 12, color: "#e2e8f0" } }
    };

    Plotly.react("plot-demo-bars", traces, layout, { responsive: true, displaylogo: false });
  }

  window.setLifeCurveMode = function (m) {
    curveMode = m;
    document.getElementById("life-est-w").classList.toggle("active", m === "w");
    document.getElementById("life-est-u").classList.toggle("active", m === "u");
    renderLifespanCurve();
  };

  window.setLifeMatrixMode = function (m) {
    matMode = m;
    document.getElementById("mat-est-w").classList.toggle("active", m === "w");
    document.getElementById("mat-est-u").classList.toggle("active", m === "u");
    renderLifespanMatrix();
  };

  window.setDemoMode = function (m) {
    demoMode = m;
    document.getElementById("demo-est-w").classList.toggle("active", m === "w");
    document.getElementById("demo-est-u").classList.toggle("active", m === "u");
    renderDemoBars();
  };

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    renderLifespanCurve();
    renderLifespanMatrix();
    renderDemoBars();
  });
})();
</script>
```
